Color Splash Effect

Pick a color to keep and turn everything else black-and-white — the classic color splash effect with a tolerance slider.

Lower = stricter color match.

Tip: in Chrome/Edge the color picker has an eyedropper to sample the exact color from your photo. Processed locally in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a photo.
  2. Pick the color you want to keep (use the eyedropper to sample it from the photo).
  3. Drag the tolerance slider until only your subject stays colored.
  4. Click "Download image" to save the PNG.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What does the tolerance slider do?

Tolerance controls how close a pixel's color must be to your chosen color to stay colored. Low values keep only near-exact matches; high values keep similar shades too.

How do I pick the exact color from my photo?

Click the color box, then use the eyedropper (in Chrome/Edge) to sample a color straight from your photo for a perfect match.

Is my photo uploaded?

Yes — the effect runs on your photo's pixels in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
